tools.description: List the user's OWN listing-message conversations (threads they started, or received as a listing owner), newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever this user's threads. Use get_conversation to read a thread's messages.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_image_upload, list_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation · Public sink: send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: delete_listing, update_listing_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_image_upload, list_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: get_listing, send_message, get_entitlements, reply_to_conversation · Public sink: send_message, create_listing, request_image_upload, get_entitlements, update_listing, update_listing_images · Destructive: delete_listing, update_listing_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
